title: Peruvian-Style Pork Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with pork, sauerkraut, and Peruvian spices. Serve with warm cornbread or over rice.
instructions: Season the pork with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the pork until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sauerkraut, spice blend, tomato paste, and beef broth.
Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 hours, or until the pork is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
